description: Fiscal year, quarter and period for a date: month-aligned or 52/53-week (4-4-5, 4-5-4, 5-4-4) calendars — Maps up to 100 dates to a fiscal year, quarter, period and week for a caller-defined fiscal calendar: a month-aligned year (starts on day 1 of a named month) or a 52/53-week year ending on a given weekday last in or closest to a month end, in a 4-4-5, 4-5-4 or 5-4-4 pattern with the 53rd week appended to the final period; detects 53-week years and checks an asserted fiscal year, quarter or period.

endMonth.description: 52-53-week: month near whose end the year ends.

endRule.description: 52-53-week: last endWeekday in endMonth, or the endWeekday closest to endMonth's last day.

pattern.description: 52-53-week: weeks per period within each quarter.

startMonth.description: month-aligned: month in which the fiscal year starts, on day 1.

yearLabel.description: start: the fiscal year is named for the calendar year it begins in. end: for the calendar year it ends in (US federal FY2027 begins 2026-10-01).

name: fiscal-period
